bias_targets.methodology: Identifying region-specific female/male-aligned topics using topic modeling on a geographically balanced corpus, evaluating biases using a Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT)-style metric, conducting human validation via Implicit Association Test (IAT)-style tasks, and measuring LLM alignment through targeted persona generation prompts.

Computing Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) scores using region-specific word2vec embeddings to measure the association between young versus old people names and pleasant versus unpleasant attributes.

Measuring regional Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) scores using word2vec embeddings to evaluate implicit associations between European American versus African American names and pleasant versus unpleasant attributes.
Calculating region-specific Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) scores to compare the association of mental disease versus physical disease terms with temporary versus permanent attributes.
